cues.fragment: Ooh, ooh / Not spinnin' anymore, you won't see me wasted
cues.title: Atmospheric Head-Voice Intro
cues.text: Open with a soft, airy head-voice 'Ooh' (up to F4) before settling into relaxed, conversational phrasing on 'Not spinnin' anymore'; keep dynamics light (35% strength) and steady (88% sustain).

cues.fragment: Smoking in the park, underneath the trees / Perfect time for me
cues.title: Smooth Groove & Lift to Bb4
cues.text: Lock into the laid-back R&B pocket around F3–G4, then release cleanly into head mix on 'Perfect time for me' (10-semitone span up to Bb4) without throat squeeze.

cues.fragment: Underneath the stars, feels just like a dream / A dream, a dream, a dream
cues.title: Wide 19-Semitone Sweep & Agile Echoes
cues.text: Second-widest pitch sweep of the track (19 semitones on 'Underneath the stars'), followed by light, nimble runs on the repeating 'a dream, a dream, a dream' hook.

cues.fragment: I'll take you wherever you wanna go / Come find me, I can be your therapist
cues.title: Warm Vibrato Pocket (53%)
cues.text: Float up to Bb4 on 'wherever you wanna go', then drop into warm, resonant chest voice around D4 with rich vibrato (53%) on 'Come find me, I can be your therapist'.

cues.fragment: All the weight on your heart, you can lay it on my shoulders
cues.title: Peak Sustain (98%) & Dynamic Anchor
cues.text: Highest sustain (98%) and co-strongest dynamic presence (75% strength) in the song: hold 'shoulders' with steady rib support and warm 61% vibrato up to G4.

cues.fragment: We can't see the haters, we're too high out here / pull up on me later at the spot
cues.title: Building Mix & Dynamic Lift
cues.text: Connect 'we're too high out here' with 89% sustain around A4, then drive forward with 75% vocal strength across an 11-semitone arc into 'at the spot' before Chorus 2.

cues.fragment: Smoke one in the park, underneath the trees
cues.title: Widest Range Span (24 Semitones)
cues.text: Largest pitch span (24 semitones) and second-highest agility in the track: navigate the low pickup into the G4 chorus hook cleanly, keeping the larynx neutral.

cues.fragment: Underneath the stars, feels just like a dream / A dream, a dream, a dream
cues.title: Vibrato Bloom & 92% Legato Sustain
cues.text: Let natural vibrato bloom (51%) on 'Underneath the stars', then spin a seamless 92% sustained line through 'feels just like a dream' without breaking airflow.

cues.title: Soaring Falsetto Bridge (C5–D5)
cues.text: After the instrumental break, float effortlessly into pure head voice soaring to C5 and D5; keep vowels tall and narrow with zero neck tension.

cues.fragment: And if you're free, you can pull up on me later at the spot
cues.title: Controlled 93% Sustain into Final Hook
cues.text: Span 11 semitones cleanly up to A4, then anchor 'at the spot' with 93% sustain and 41% vibrato to set up the climactic final chorus.

cues.fragment: Underneath the trees / Perfect time for me to set you free
cues.title: C5 Climax & Peak Vibrato (64%)
cues.text: Push into radiant C5 ad-libs on 'Underneath the trees' and 'Perfect time for me', then unleash the song's richest vibrato (64%) and 91% sustain on 'to set you free'.

cues.fragment: Feels just like a dream / A dream, a dream, a dream
cues.title: Highest Note (C#5) & Peak Agility Run
cues.text: Hit the track's highest sustained melodic peak (C#5) on 'Feels just like a dream', then finish with the song's fastest, most agile 15-semitone riff on 'A dream, a dream, a dream'.
